Title: Login - Temporary Lockout
Preconditions:
Create in-case (FIFTH RULE; random-data uniqueEmail with the AGENT-TEST-LOCKOUT prefix): ONE storefront Customer account with a contact (userName == email, password {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}), lockout enabled, accessFailedCount 0, not locked. Nothing else signs in as it, so its failed-attempt counter counts only this case's wrong passwords. Shared personas ({{USER_EMAIL}}, {{ORG_USER_EMAIL}}, the agent pool) are never locked.
Account lockout enabled after 5 failed attempts; the lockout window is environment configuration - never assume its length.
Steps:
--- LAYER: Fixture (REST, created in-case) ---
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token
[SETUP] Generate with random-data (AGENT-TEST-LOCKOUT prefix): email (uniqueEmail) - the email is also the userName
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/members {"memberType":"Contact","firstName":"Agent","lastName":"Lockout","fullName":"Agent Lockout","name":"Agent Lockout","emails":[email]}; capture contactId
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/create {"userName":email,"email":email,"password":"{{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}","storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","memberId":contactId,"userType":"Customer","emailConfirmed":true,"status":"Approved","lockoutEnabled":true}; GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/{email} and capture userId
[ASSERT] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/{userId}/locked answers locked=false and the user reads back lockoutEnabled=true - otherwise BLOCKED: the fixture did not land, and a lockout verdict on an account that cannot lock proves nothing. Record email, userId and contactId in the run evidence
--- SCREEN: Sign in with wrong passwords until the lockout ---
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] Fill 'Email': email
[ACT] Fill 'Password': 'WrongPass1!'
[ACT] Click 'Sign In'
[ACT] Repeat incorrect login 4 more times (5 total)
[ASSERT] Lockout message displayed after 5th attempt
[ACT] Attempt login with correct credentials ('Password': {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}})
[ASSERT] Login still denied due to lockout
[WAIT] Wait for lockout timeout period
[ACT] Attempt login again with correct credentials ('Password': {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}})
Assertions:
[DOM] Lockout error message shown after 5 failed attempts
[STATE] Login with correct credentials fails during lockout period
[STATE] Login succeeds after lockout timeout expires
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] POST /connect/token returns 4xx during lockout
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS errors
Failure_Signals: No lockout after 5 failures; lockout persists beyond timeout; correct password accepted during lockout; console TypeError
Cleanup:
[HTTP] Sign out of the storefront if a session is open. POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/{userId}/unlock with the admin Bearer token (by user id, never by userName); read back GET .../users/{userId}/locked locked=false
[HTTP] DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users?names=email, then DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/members?ids=contactId; read back that the user and the contact no longer resolve (the AGENT-TEST- prefix sweep is the backstop if this fails)

Title: Login - Org-Blocked User (VCST-5028)
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
Create in-case (FIFTH RULE; random-data uniqueEmail/uniqueOrgName, AGENT-TEST-6132 prefix): a SINGLE-ORG storefront Customer - ONE organization (orgLocked), ONE buyer whose contact belongs to it and holds a membership row in it (userName == email, password {{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}) - whose ONLY membership is then locked through the REST membership lock endpoint (the admin-side equivalent of lockOrganizationContact). State under test: nothing accessible, and the buyer's platform account is NOT locked. A second organization (orgUsable) is added in the multi-org variant only. Shared personas (MULTI_ORG_USER_*, MULTI_ORG_TF_BR*, {{USER_EMAIL}}) are never touched.
Build under test: VirtoCommerce.Customer >= 3.1030.0 (VCST-6132 organization fallback, released). Expected result source: BL-AUTH-016 (VCST-6132 description + QA comment 2026-10-14; release note 'Fall back to an accessible organization on OTP and MFA sign-in (#321)'). On an older build record the case BLOCKED for the build, never FAIL, and never re-base it to the old behaviour.
NOTE: a REFUSAL for a locked organization belongs only to an EXPLICIT org switch (grant_type=refresh_token minted after the lock, HTTP 400 user_is_locked_in_organization - BL-AUTH-012 / BL-AUTH-013), never to a credential sign-in. This case therefore expects NO refusal. The earlier expectation (login denied, 4xx) read VCST-5028 before VCST-6132 and was re-based on 2026-10-21.
Test_Data: url={{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in; back_url={{BACK_URL}}; admin={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}; admin_password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}; storeId={{STORE_ID}}
Steps:
--- LAYER: Fixture (REST, created in-case) ---
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token
[SETUP] Generate with random-data (AGENT-TEST-6132 prefix): orgLockedName and orgUsableName (uniqueOrgName) and email (uniqueEmail) - the email is also the userName
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/members {"memberType":"Organization","name":orgLockedName}; capture orgLockedId
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/members {"memberType":"Contact","firstName":"Agent","lastName":"T6132","fullName":"Agent T6132","name":"Agent T6132","emails":[email],"organizations":[orgLockedId]}; capture contactId
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/create {"userName":email,"email":email,"password":"{{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}","storeId":"{{STORE_ID}}","memberId":contactId,"userType":"Customer","emailConfirmed":true,"status":"Approved"}; GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/{email} and capture userId
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/roles/search {"keyword":"Purchasing agent","take":5}; capture roleId, roleName
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships {"userId":userId,"organizationId":orgLockedId,"organizationName":orgLockedName,"roles":[{"roleId":roleId,"roleName":roleName}],"isLocked":false}; POST .../organization-memberships/search {"userId":userId,"take":50} and capture mLocked
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/customer/organization-memberships/{mLocked}/lock {"lockoutEnd":null}; then POST .../search {"userId":userId,"take":50} and read back isCurrentlyLocked=true (a /lock on an unknown id answers 200 with a null body - never trust the status alone)
[ASSERT] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/{userId}/locked answers locked=false - otherwise BLOCKED: the fixture is not the org-scoped state under test. Record email, userId, contactId and orgLockedId in the run evidence
--- LAYER: Token (REST) - single-org buyer, locked in its only organization ---
